help_how_body: Type your secret message, tap Encrypt, and share the generated link. The recipient opens the link and the message is decrypted using AES 256-bit — once only. After reading, it is permanently and irrevocably deleted from the server.
help_security_body: All messages are encrypted with AES 256-bit — a standard used by banks and governments. Encrypted data is stored only as ciphertext and deleted immediately after the first opening. No plaintext ever leaves your device.
help_faq_q1: Can I read a message more than once?
help_faq_a1: No. Messages self-destruct immediately after the first decryption and are irrevocably deleted from the server.
help_faq_q2: What happens if I lose the link?
help_faq_a2: The message cannot be recovered. There is no backup. Since the message deletes itself after opening, maximum discretion is guaranteed.
help_faq_q3: What does the Premium feature offer?
help_faq_a3: Premium users get extremely short, memorable links (only 5 dynamic digits after domezos-ware.com/), made possible by a secure, encrypted database in the background.
help_faq_q4: Can Premium be restored after reinstallation or a reset?
help_faq_a4: No. Premium is tied to a single anonymous device token that is generated fresh on every installation. We intentionally store no personal data and cannot track devices.
info_crypto_note: Messages are encrypted with AES 256-bit (bank standard). Self-destructing links guarantee that your secrets disappear forever after reading once.
info_web_note: Premium and Tip features are only available in the Android app and are not offered in this web version.
trust_e2e_desc: The server cannot read your message; the password is only in the link.
trust_burn_desc: The message is permanently deleted after the first read.
